newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Ten killed in blaze after trucks crash in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Ten killed in blaze after trucks crash in Morocco.

text.p: Ten people were burnt to death after two trucks, one carrying petroleum products, collided in central Morocco, Bayane al-Youm newspaper said on Thursday.
The accident occurred earlier this week near Berchid, between Morocco's financial centre Casablanca and the town of Settat.
The newspaper said the fire lasted more than seven hours and it was impossible to identify the badly burnt victims.
